$comment: /api/* is NOT ours — every path under it is proxied to Django, so a Next
route handler placed there is unreachable in production while working fine
in `next dev` (which does not apply this file). Anything Next serves itself
must live outside /api: the share card is at /card/profile/<username>.
No trailing slash on the source either — /api/foo/ round-trips through a
Vercel 308 into Django's APPEND_SLASH 301, which drops the /api prefix.
